title: Who Makes the Rules for the Garden?
title_ja: 学校の庭のルールを誰が決める？
fact_notes: さくら学校の庭と試行は架空の教育用事例。校則の意思決定に関する独自教材。

sentences.en: The students at Sakura School share a garden behind the library.
sentences.ja: さくら学校の生徒たちは図書館の裏の庭を共同で使っています。

sentences.en: Some grow vegetables there, while others use the benches to read.
sentences.ja: 野菜を育てる生徒もいれば、ベンチで読書する生徒もいます。

sentences.en: Recently, the school has received complaints about noise and litter.
sentences.ja: 最近、学校には騒音やごみについての苦情が寄せられました。

sentences.en: A teacher suggests closing the garden during lunch to solve the problem.
sentences.ja: 教師は問題を解決するため昼休みの庭を閉鎖しようと提案します。

sentences.en: However, many students believe that the garden is important to their school day.
sentences.ja: しかし、多くの生徒は庭が学校生活にとって大切だと思っています。

sentences.en: The student council asks for a meeting before the rule is changed.
sentences.ja: 生徒会は規則を変える前に会議を開くよう求めます。

sentences.en: At the meeting, students describe how they use the garden.
sentences.ja: 会議では生徒たちが庭の使い方を説明します。

sentences.en: One student enjoys a quiet place to read after a busy morning.
sentences.ja: ある生徒は忙しい午前中の後に静かに読書する場所を楽しんでいます。

sentences.en: Another student needs the garden to water plants for a science project.
sentences.ja: 別の生徒は理科の活動で植物に水をやるため庭が必要です。

sentences.en: For example, the vegetable group visits the garden every day to check the soil.
sentences.ja: 例えば、野菜のグループは毎日庭を訪れ、土を確認します。

sentences.en: The teacher learns that closing the garden would affect several activities.
sentences.ja: 教師は庭を閉じると複数の活動に影響すると知ります。

sentences.en: Everyone agrees that cleaning and safety must remain important.
sentences.ja: 清掃と安全は引き続き大切だという点では全員が一致します。

sentences.en: The council suggests new signs asking visitors to use the bins.
sentences.ja: 生徒会は来訪者にごみ箱の利用を求める新しい掲示を提案します。

sentences.en: They also suggest a quiet area away from the benches used for group talks.
sentences.ja: グループで話すベンチから離れた静かな区域も提案します。

sentences.en: Instead of choosing between a complete ban and no rules, the school tries both changes.
sentences.ja: 全面禁止か無規則かを選ぶのではなく、学校は両方の変更を試します。

sentences.en: A small team of volunteers offers to check the garden after lunch.
sentences.ja: 小さなボランティアのチームが昼食後に庭を見回ると申し出ます。

sentences.en: They do not want to punish classmates; they want to keep the shared place pleasant.
sentences.ja: 同級生を罰したいのではなく、共有の場所を快適に保ちたいのです。

sentences.en: The school agrees to test the new plan for two weeks.
sentences.ja: 学校は新しい計画を2週間試すことに同意します。

sentences.en: At the end of the trial, the council asks students and teachers for feedback.
sentences.ja: 試行期間の終わりに生徒会は生徒と教師に意見を求めます。

sentences.en: Most say the signs are useful, but some still hear loud conversations.
sentences.ja: 多くは掲示が役立つと言いますが、大きな声の会話が聞こえる人もいます。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the school decides not to close the entire garden immediately.
sentences.ja: それでも学校は庭全体をすぐに閉じないことにします。

sentences.en: The council adds a simple map showing where people may talk or read.
sentences.ja: 生徒会は話したり読んだりできる区域を示す簡単な地図を追加します。

sentences.en: The teacher thanks students for explaining both problems and possible solutions.
sentences.ja: 教師は問題だけでなく可能な解決策も説明したことに感謝します。

sentences.en: Students learn that rules can be improved through listening and testing.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは聞き取りと試行を通じて規則を改善できると学びます。

sentences.en: Several months later, the garden remains open during lunch.
sentences.ja: 数か月後も庭は昼休みに開かれています。

sentences.en: The volunteers still collect litter and report broken equipment.
sentences.ja: ボランティアは引き続きごみを集め、壊れた設備を報告します。

sentences.en: Therefore, the shared space requires work even after the new rules are written.
sentences.ja: したがって新しい規則を書いた後も共有の場所には手入れが必要です。

sentences.en: Students also understand that different people may need the same place in different ways.
sentences.ja: 同じ場所を人によって異なる形で必要とすることも理解しています。

sentences.en: They feel proud that their opinions helped improve the school.
sentences.ja: 自分たちの意見が学校をよくする助けになったことを誇りに思っています。

sentences.en: The garden is now a lesson in responsibility as well as a place to relax.
sentences.ja: 庭はくつろぐ場所であると同時に責任を学ぶ場所にもなっています。

questions.prompt: Where is the shared garden?
questions.explanation_ja: 第1段落から「Behind the library.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What complaints did the school receive?
questions.explanation_ja: 第1段落から「Noise and litter.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What did one teacher first suggest?
questions.explanation_ja: 第1段落から「Closing the garden at lunchtime.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: Why did the council ask for a meeting?
options: Students wanted their needs considered before a rule change.
The council planned a sports festival.
questions.explanation_ja: 第1段落から「Students wanted their needs considered before a rule change.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: Why did one student need a quiet place?
options: To read after a busy morning.
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落から「To read after a busy morning.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: How did the science group use the garden?
options: To water plants and check the soil.
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落から「To water plants and check the soil.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What did the teacher realize?
options: Closing the garden would affect several activities.
The garden was unsafe at all times.
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落から「Closing the garden would affect several activities.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What did everyone agree was important?
questions.explanation_ja: 第2段落から「Cleaning and safety.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What did the proposed signs ask people to do?
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落から「Put rubbish in bins.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: Why did the council propose a quiet area?
options: To separate reading from group conversations.
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落から「To separate reading from group conversations.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What two extremes did the school avoid?
options: A total ban and having no rules.
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落から「A total ban and having no rules.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: How long was the trial?
questions.explanation_ja: 第3段落から「Two weeks.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What did most feedback say about signs?
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落から「They were helpful.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What problem remained?
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落から「Some conversations were too loud.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What did the council add after the trial?
options: A map showing areas for talking and reading.
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落から「A map showing areas for talking and reading.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What did students learn about rules?
options: Listening and testing can improve rules.
questions.explanation_ja: 第4段落から「Listening and testing can improve rules.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: Why do volunteers still work months later?
options: The council has removed the signs.
questions.explanation_ja: 第5段落から「Shared spaces need continuing care.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What do students understand about people?
options: Shared places are always easy to manage.
Different people can need one place in different ways.
questions.explanation_ja: 第5段落から「Different people can need one place in different ways.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: Why do students feel proud?
options: They stopped other students from speaking.
Their views helped improve their school.
questions.explanation_ja: 第5段落から「Their views helped improve their school.」が正しいと判断できます。

questions.prompt: What is the central message?
options: Fair rules for shared places require listening, testing, and care.
All gardens must be closed at lunch.
Students should not discuss school decisions.
questions.explanation_ja: 第5段落から「Fair rules for shared places require listening, testing, and care.」が正しいと判断できます。

grammar.focus: closing the garden would affect several activities
grammar.explanation_ja: 動名詞closingが主語として働き、wouldが結果を表します。

grammar.focus: Instead of choosing between a complete ban and no rules
grammar.explanation_ja: instead of +動名詞は『二者択一する代わりに』です。

grammar.focus: showing where people may talk or read
grammar.explanation_ja: 現在分詞showingがmapを説明しています。

grammar.focus: as well as a place to relax
grammar.explanation_ja: as well asは『〜だけでなく』です。

discourse.role_ja: 閉鎖案に対する反対意見を示します。
理科の活動の具体例を示します。
両極端の選択に代わる試行を示します。
課題が残る中でも閉鎖しない判断を述べます。
継続的な手入れが必要という結論です。

paraphrases.source: The student council asks for a meeting before the rule is changed.
paraphrases.rewrite: The council wants students to discuss the rule before it changes.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 決定前に意見を聞くという意味です。

paraphrases.source: The teacher learns that closing the garden would affect several activities.
paraphrases.rewrite: Closing the garden would interfere with several school activities.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 複数の活動に影響が出るという意味です。

paraphrases.source: Instead of choosing between a complete ban and no rules, the school tries both changes.
paraphrases.rewrite: The school tests alternatives rather than banning everything.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 全面禁止以外の方法を試すという意味です。

paraphrases.source: Students learn that rules can be improved through listening and testing.
paraphrases.rewrite: Rules can get better when people listen and try changes.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 試行と傾聴による規則改善の意味です。

paraphrases.source: The garden is now a lesson in responsibility as well as a place to relax.
paraphrases.rewrite: The garden teaches responsibility as well as offering relaxation.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 庭にはくつろぎと学びの両面があるということです。
